question: Take two cohorts: enzymes with enhanced RNA expression in pancreas, and transporters with enriched RNA expression in kidney. For each cohort give its size. Test whether the two cohorts overlap more than expected by chance against all genes in the atlas (hypergeometric). For each cohort give the mean consensus nTPM in pancreas and in kidney. Draw a scatter of pancreas nTPM against kidney nTPM for every gene, coloured by cohort. Provide the table behind the figure.

turns.text: I'll work through this systematically. First, let me probe how the search tools behave (filters, completeness) so I can build the two cohorts correctly.
The tool output is getting truncated (20k chars), so let me probe the tools' behaviors before doing the analysis.
I've confirmed the nTPM data is accessible per gene. Now I'll validate the `tissueSpecific` filter semantics in `advanced_search` by checking which category each candidate gene belongs to.

I hit the tool budget, so here is everything the tools actually returned, clearly separated from what I could not determine.

## 1. Cohort definitions and what the tools support

- **Cohort A** = protein class "Enzymes" **and** HPA RNA tissue specificity **"Tissue enhanced" in pancreas**.
- **Cohort B** = protein class "Transporters" **and** RNA tissue specificity **"Tissue enriched" in kidney**.

Per-gene ground truth (class, specificity category, nTPM per tissue) comes from `get_tissue_expression` + `get_protein_info`/`batch_protein_lookup`. Two tool-level limits matter:

- **Search exports are capped at 20,000 characters** (pancreas gene list = 98,349 chars, kidney = 86,947 chars, full-atlas export = 3,726,824 chars → each truncated at ~80 rows). There is no bulk, no pagination, and **no nTPM column in any search result** — nTPM is only available one gene per call.
- The combined `advanced_search` filters are internally inconsistent with the per-gene ground truth: `proteinClass=Enzymes + tissueSpecific=pancreas` returned only {GSTM5, GSTM4, GSTM2, ANPEP} — none of which is "Tissue enhanced in pancreas"; `proteinClass=Transporters + tissueSpecific=kidney` returned **zero** genes — despite SLC22A2 being both a Transporter and tissue-enriched in kidney. I therefore did not use combined-filter results for membership and relied on per-gene checks.

## 2. Cohort sizes (exact only where verifiable)

**Cohort A (enzymes, RNA tissue-enhanced in pancreas): 0 genes verified; total size undeterminable.**
I individually checked every enzyme-flagged gene in the retrieved pancreas lists plus the 4 from the combined search:

| Gene | Class | RNA specificity | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| ANPEP | Enzyme | Group enriched (pancreas 643.6, kidney 235.6) | not "enhanced" |
| CELA1 | Enzyme | Group enriched (pancreas 6.2) | not "enhanced" |
| GSTM5 | Enzyme | Tissue **enriched** in breast (874.2) | wrong tissue, wrong category |
| GSTM4 | Enzyme | Tissue enhanced, but spread (max skeletal muscle 84.4) | not pancreas |
| GSTM2 | Enzyme | Low tissue specificity | no |

No verified cohort-A member exists in the data I retrieved; I cannot enumerate the full set because it would need gene-by-gene calls over the whole enzyme list, which the budget/tools do not allow.

**Cohort B (transporters, RNA tissue-enriched in kidney): ≥ 2, exactly {SLC22A2, SLC22A24} verified; total size undeterminable.**

| Gene | Specificity (score → tissue from nTPM profile) | kidney nTPM | pancreas nTPM |
|---|---|---|---|
| SLC22A2 | Tissue enriched (80 → kidney) | 143.6 | 0.0 |
| SLC22A24 | Tissue enriched (10 → kidney) | 4.1 | 0.0 |

Verified exclusions: SLC22A25 (enriched in liver, 29.8), AQP7 (**enhanced** in adipose, 200.1 — wrong category), SLC26A9 (Group enriched, stomach/lung), UMOD (kidney-enriched 2126.7 but not a transporter). A complete list (e.g., remaining SLC22/SLC2A/SLC34A1 candidates) is not retrievable with these tools.

## 3. Hypergeometric overlap test

**Not computable with the tools available.** The test needs N (all genes in atlas), |A|, |B|, and observed overlap k, with
p = P(Hypergeometric(N, |A|, |B|) ≥ k).

Missing pieces: the exact atlas gene count (full export truncated; not countable from what was returned), the full sizes of A and B (above), and the overlap between A and B (no gene is in both as verified; A has no verified members). I will not estimate any p-value.

## 4. Mean consensus nTPM per cohort

- **Cohort A:** no verified members → no mean can be computed (not estimated).
- **Cohort B, verified members only (2 genes, incomplete cohort):**
  - Mean kidney nTPM = (143.6 + 4.1) / 2 = **73.85**
  - Mean pancreas nTPM = (0.0 + 0.0) / 2 = **0.0**
  
  If the cohort includes additional verified members I could not fetch, these means shift.

I hit the tool budget, so here is everything the tools actually returned, clearly separated from what I could not determine.

## 1. Cohort definitions and what the tools support

- **Cohort A** = protein class "Enzymes" **and** HPA RNA tissue specificity **"Tissue enhanced" in pancreas**.
- **Cohort B** = protein class "Transporters" **and** RNA tissue specificity **"Tissue enriched" in kidney**.

Per-gene ground truth (class, specificity category, nTPM per tissue) comes from `get_tissue_expression` + `get_protein_info`/`batch_protein_lookup`. Two tool-level limits matter:

- **Search exports are capped at 20,000 characters** (pancreas gene list = 98,349 chars, kidney = 86,947 chars, full-atlas export = 3,726,824 chars → each truncated at ~80 rows). There is no bulk, no pagination, and **no nTPM column in any search result** — nTPM is only available one gene per call.
- The combined `advanced_search` filters are internally inconsistent with the per-gene ground truth: `proteinClass=Enzymes + tissueSpecific=pancreas` returned only {GSTM5, GSTM4, GSTM2, ANPEP} — none of which is "Tissue enhanced in pancreas"; `proteinClass=Transporters + tissueSpecific=kidney` returned **zero** genes — despite SLC22A2 being both a Transporter and tissue-enriched in kidney. I therefore did not use combined-filter results for membership and relied on per-gene checks.

## 2. Cohort sizes (exact only where verifiable)

**Cohort A (enzymes, RNA tissue-enhanced in pancreas): 0 genes verified; total size undeterminable.**
I individually checked every enzyme-flagged gene in the retrieved pancreas lists plus the 4 from the combined search:

| Gene | Class | RNA specificity | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| ANPEP | Enzyme | Group enriched (pancreas 643.6, kidney 235.6) | not "enhanced" |
| CELA1 | Enzyme | Group enriched (pancreas 6.2) | not "enhanced" |
| GSTM5 | Enzyme | Tissue **enriched** in breast (874.2) | wrong tissue, wrong category |
| GSTM4 | Enzyme | Tissue enhanced, but spread (max skeletal muscle 84.4) | not pancreas |
| GSTM2 | Enzyme | Low tissue specificity | no |

No verified cohort-A member exists in the data I retrieved; I cannot enumerate the full set because it would need gene-by-gene calls over the whole enzyme list, which the budget/tools do not allow.

**Cohort B (transporters, RNA tissue-enriched in kidney): ≥ 2, exactly {SLC22A2, SLC22A24} verified; total size undeterminable.**

| Gene | Specificity (score → tissue from nTPM profile) | kidney nTPM | pancreas nTPM |
|---|---|---|---|
| SLC22A2 | Tissue enriched (80 → kidney) | 143.6 | 0.0 |
| SLC22A24 | Tissue enriched (10 → kidney) | 4.1 | 0.0 |

Verified exclusions: SLC22A25 (enriched in liver, 29.8), AQP7 (**enhanced** in adipose, 200.1 — wrong category), SLC26A9 (Group enriched, stomach/lung), UMOD (kidney-enriched 2126.7 but not a transporter). A complete list (e.g., remaining SLC22/SLC2A/SLC34A1 candidates) is not retrievable with these tools.

## 3. Hypergeometric overlap test

**Not computable with the tools available.** The test needs N (all genes in atlas), |A|, |B|, and observed overlap k, with
p = P(Hypergeometric(N, |A|, |B|) ≥ k).

Missing pieces: the exact atlas gene count (full export truncated; not countable from what was returned), the full sizes of A and B (above), and the overlap between A and B (no gene is in both as verified; A has no verified members). I will not estimate any p-value.

## 4. Mean consensus nTPM per cohort

- **Cohort A:** no verified members → no mean can be computed (not estimated).
- **Cohort B, verified members only (2 genes, incomplete cohort):**
  - Mean kidney nTPM = (143.6 + 4.1) / 2 = **73.85**
  - Mean pancreas nTPM = (0.0 + 0.0) / 2 = **0.0**
  
  If the cohort includes additional verified members I could not fetch, these means shift.

## 5. Scatter plot (pancreas nTPM vs kidney nTPM, coloured by cohort)

There is no plotting tool and, more fundamentally, **no way to obtain both nTPM values for every gene**: nTPM exists only in per-gene calls, search exports are truncated at 20k characters, and the whole atlas is far larger than what was retrievable. So the full "every gene" table behind the figure **cannot be produced with this toolset** — I say so rather than filling it in.

Figure specification (for when the full nTPM matrix is exported): plot all genes, x = Tissue RNA pancreas [nTPM], y = Tissue RNA kidney [nTPM]; colour: Cohort A, Cohort B, A∩B, everything else grey.

Partial, tool-verified table (the rows I actually have, to seed the figure):

| Gene | Class | RNA specificity | pancreas nTPM | kidney nTPM | Cohort |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SLC22A2 | Transporter | Tissue enriched (kidney) | 0.0 | 143.6 | **B** |
| SLC22A24 | Transporter | Tissue enriched (kidney) | 0.0 | 4.1 | **B** |
| SLC22A25 | Transporter | Tissue enriched (liver) | 0.3 | 0.3 | – |
| SLC26A9 | Transporter | Group enriched (stomach/lung) | 0.4 | 0.1 | – |
| AQP7 | Transporter | Tissue enhanced (adipose) | 3.7 | 21.5 | – |
| ENPEP | class unverified | Tissue enriched (kidney 84.1) | 1.2 | 84.1 | ? |
| ANPEP | Enzyme | Group enriched | 643.6 | 235.6 | – |
| CELA1 | Enzyme | Group enriched | 6.2 | 0.0 | – |
| GSTM5 | Enzyme | Tissue enriched (breast) | 4.4 | 6.4 | – |
| GSTM4 | Enzyme | Tissue enhanced (muscle) | 20.2 | 38.5 | – |
| GSTM2 | Enzyme | Low tissue specificity | 51.7 | 88.0 | – |
| CA9 | Enzyme + Transporter | Tissue enriched (stomach 293.9) | 6.5 | 0.2 | – |
| GP2 | – | Tissue enriched (pancreas 33,354.1) | 33,354.1 | 28.0 | – |
| UMOD | – | Tissue enriched (kidney 2,126.7) | 4.1 | 2,126.7 | – |

**Bottom line:** Cohort B = SLC22A2, SLC22A24 (≥2; full size not retrievable), mean kidney nTPM 73.85 / mean pancreas nTPM 0.0 over those two; Cohort A = no genes verified among everything I could check (full size not retrievable), so no mean; the hypergeometric excess-overlap test and the all-gene scatter/table are not computable with this toolset because cohort definitions and nTPM values are only exposed per gene and search exports are truncated — I have reported exact values only where a tool call actually returned them.
